Class LeaderBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.LeaderBoard
public class LeaderBoard extends Object
Represents a leaderboard for tracking and managing player rankings in a game.

    • LeaderBoard

      public LeaderBoard(GameMode mode)
      Initializes the leaderboard based on the specified game mode.
      Parameters:
      mode - the game mode which determines the leaderboard configuration; must be LEVEL_1 or LEVEL_2.
      Throws:
      GameSettingsException - if an invalid game mode is provided.

    • getDays

      public int getDays(Player player)
      Retrieves the number of days a player has spent in the leaderboard.

    • modifyFlightDays

      public void modifyFlightDays(Player player, int daysModified)
      Modifies the flight days of a player in the leaderboard.
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose flight days are to be modified
      daysModified - the number of days to be added or removed from the player's flight days
      Throws:
      IllegalSetOfNextPlayerException - if the player is not present in the leaderboard

      public void remove(Player player)

      player - the player to be removed from the leaderboard

    • getPlayerConnectedStartingFromThisPosition

      public Player getPlayerConnectedStartingFromThisPosition(int position)
      Retrieves the first connected player starting from the given position.

      IllegalSetOfNextPlayerException - if no connected player is found after the given position
